Recoil-dampening bracers.name: Recoil-dampening bracers
Recoil-dampening bracers.description: Padded forearm bracers with shock-absorbing cores that soak up part of the kickback when a Quirk fires through the hands or arms. They reduce recoil without removing it: a user who pushes past their limit still gets hurt. [ Support Gear | About ¥85,000 ]
